Upper Text: [When Digivolving] If [MetalGarurumon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, until the end of your opponent's turn, all of their Digimon gain "[When Attacking] Lose 4 memory."
[When Attacking] By returning 1 Digimon card from your trash to the bottom of the deck, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the same level as that card.
